Marketplace Tasks.Description: Decide whether sellers can be individual creators (not just verified brands) before writing the catalog service — this changes several foreign keys.
Create merch_products and merch_variants tables (SKU, size/color variants, pricing in INR/USD cents, stock_qty, weight, print_file_url, artwork_id link).
Create print_providers table to store POD partner config (Printful/Printify/manual) with integration_type and api_config jsonb.
Build onboarding API endpoints for new sellers, reusing brand_verification_requests pattern for KYC/KYB where applicable.
Build the multi-step seller onboarding screens (profile, payout details, KYC document upload, verification status) consuming the onboarding API.
Scaffold the seller dashboard shell/navigation (products, orders, payouts placeholders) that later phases will fill in.
Create carts and cart_items tables and CRUD endpoints to support persistent multi-item, multi-seller shopping carts (item_type: license or merch_variant).
Add seller_id, item_type, merch_variant_id, and cart_id columns to orders/order_items so a single order can span multiple sellers.
Create addresses table and endpoints for buyer shipping addresses (line1/2, city, state, postal_code, country, is_default).

Marketplace Tasks.Task Title: Build fulfillments table + manual status update API
Marketplace Tasks.Description: Create fulfillments and fulfillment_items tables with manual status update endpoints (fulfillment_type = in_house_stock, no POD integration yet).
Build read APIs for browsing/searching the small standalone merch catalog (product + variant listing, filters).

Marketplace Tasks.Task Title: Merch catalog browse & product detail pages
Marketplace Tasks.Description: Build the storefront pages for browsing merch products, filtering, and viewing a product detail page with variant (size/color) selection.
Build the cart drawer/page: add/remove items, quantity updates, mixed license + merch_variant line items, multi-seller grouping.
Build the checkout flow: address selection/entry, order summary split by seller, and payment step.
Build the address book management screen (add/edit/delete/set default) on top of the addresses API.
Build the internal seller-facing screen to view orders and manually mark fulfillment status (pending/shipped/delivered) with tracking info.
Build the print-on-demand integration with Printful/Printify, including order-status webhooks (the main async path in the system).
Build the pipeline that generates/serves print-ready files from the existing cdn_files asset registry.

Marketplace Tasks.Task Title: Turn on artwork_id linking on merch_products
Marketplace Tasks.Description: Enable linking a merch_product to its originating artwork so contest-winning/brand fanart can be sold as merch.
Build the backend endpoint(s) that take an approved artwork and generate a draft merch_product/variant with print_file_url set.

Marketplace Tasks.Task Title: 'Turn this artwork into merch' creator flow UI
Marketplace Tasks.Description: Build the creator-facing flow: pick a product template, preview artwork-on-product mockup, set pricing, and publish the merch listing.
Surface print-provider order status (in production/shipped/delivered/failed) to buyers and sellers, driven by the webhook-updated fulfillment records.
Determine whether printing someone else's artwork onto merch requires a commercial license purchase or a separate merch-rights grant, and whether merch_products needs a license_id FK.

Marketplace Tasks.Task Title: Build payouts ledger + Stripe Connect transfers
Marketplace Tasks.Description: Create the payouts table (gross/platform_fee/net cents, status, stripe_transfer_id) and automate seller payouts against Stripe Connect.
Decide whether platform fee is flat or varies by fulfillment/product type (POD margins are thinner than digital licenses) and build the rule table accordingly.
Create product_reviews table (reviewer, target_type: artwork/merch_product, order_item_id for verified purchase, rating, body) and endpoints to submit/fetch reviews.
Extend the existing generic moderation_queue (entity_type/entity_id) to cover merch listing moderation.
Build the seller-facing payouts screen: pending/paid balances, per-order breakdown, and Stripe Connect payout status.
Build the review submission form (for verified buyers) and the display of ratings/reviews on artwork and merch product pages.
Extend the existing moderation admin UI to show and action merch listings alongside other moderation entity types.
Decide whether international shipping, customs/duty, and tax-jurisdiction handling are in scope for Phase 1 or explicitly deferred to a later phase.

Marketplace Tasks.Task Title: Decide sync vs async architecture boundary
Marketplace Tasks.Description: Confirm that only print-provider webhooks and payout triggers are async (via a Postgres outbox table for now); everything else stays synchronous through the gateway.
Formalize the 5 service boundaries (Catalog, Commerce, Fulfillment, Payouts, Contests+Brand) within the shared Postgres so teams can own a slice without stepping on each other.

Marketplace Tasks.Task Title: API contract review with frontend team
Marketplace Tasks.Description: Frontend sync with backend on request/response shapes for cart, checkout, fulfillment, and payouts endpoints before UI build-out per phase.
